open_questions: Can you provide details about the tenancy agreement you have with your landlord?
Have you experienced any issues with the home that might not meet the basic living standards?
What warranty or guarantees were made by the seller about the home, and do you have any documentation?
Are there any health concerns like mold in your home that you've noticed?
Have you experienced any injuries or damages related to products used in your home?
Can you tell me more about the products you have in your home and their conditions?
Have you reported any maintenance or habitability issues to your landlord?
Have you faced any negative reactions from your landlord after making complaints?
Do you feel that your rights as a tenant have been violated in any way, such as regarding necessary repairs?
Have you received receipts for your rent payments? If not, can you describe the situation?
Did you inform your landlord about the habitability issues before considering legal action?
Can you detail the timeline of your complaints to your landlord prior to the alleged retaliation?
What steps have you taken to resolve the issues with your landlord before considering litigation?
Do you have any records of complaints you’ve made regarding discrimination or unsafe conditions?
